title: Meet the Fleet: LA County Fire Dozer 2025
description: On this episode of Meet the Fleet, meet the fleet of LA County Fire dozers clearing fire breaks (and cars) out of the way for firefighters to battle wildfires. To watch more episodes, click here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLblXY1FEJmYgIGsgjckYejK1jfQhSpPCG
